purpose: Authoritative current Toronto 158 code/name registry and source-derived Scarborough neighbourhood/ward crosswalk for TPS HOOD_158 aggregate validation; no incident data

geography.publisher: City of Toronto, Social Development, Finance & Administration
geography.citation: Toronto Social Planning Neighbourhoods v3.0, City of Toronto 2022
geography.licence_note: The official catalogue licence link is evidence; CKAN licence fields can be missing.

identifier_contract.required_validation: Exact membership in registry; 158 is the number of records, not an upper code bound
identifier_contract.do_not_join_on: Neighbourhood name or an integer range; names and punctuation are display attributes
identifier_contract.unknown_policy: Retain raw value and flag/quarantine null, unassigned, deprecated or unknown values explicitly. Never silently cast to 000, relabel or drop them from reconciliation.

scarborough_selection.method: Overlay complete official158 native geometries with the qualified official Scarborough Community Council polygon; select when intersection area / neighbourhood area >=0.5
scarborough_selection.whole_neighbourhood_aggregate_warning: This is a selected-neighbourhood geography, not exact administrative Scarborough. Preserve whole TPS neighbourhood aggregates; do not apportion crime counts by polygon area or infer the incident location. If exact administrative totals are required, this crosswalk alone is insufficient.
scarborough_selection.cross_boundary_rule: Retain all measured council and ward overlaps; do not force neighbourhoods into one ward. Bordering slivers do not make Pleasant View or other outside neighbourhoods members.
scarborough_selection.display_rule: Keep original neighbourhood identifiers/names. Council display mask does not filter aggregate records or justify clipping their counts.
scarborough_selection.point_on_surface_cross_check: All 158 point-on-surface classifications agree with majority-area classifications

substantial_multiward_examples.128: Agincourt South-Malvern West overlaps wards 22 and 23

qa.reproducibility: GDAL 3.10.3/GEOS 3.13.1; source neighbourhood geometries remain native EPSG:2952; council/wards transformed from EPSG:4326 to EPSG:2952; exact polygon intersections without simplification, snapping, ring deletion or geometry repair

tps_join_contract.historical_rule: Use HOOD_158 for this 158-model aggregate even when the incident/report date predates 2022. HOOD_140 is a different simultaneously published geography; do not mix it, rename deprecated codes or reconstruct 158 counts from 140 aggregates.
tps_join_contract.name_rule: Join on verified code, retain TPS name for provenance and City name for the registry; flag display-name differences rather than fuzzy-matching names.
tps_join_contract.scope: Metadata only was read; no TPS incident records or statistics were downloaded in this qualification
tps_join_contract.publisher_caveat: TPS says locations are privacy-offset and neighbourhood/division counts may not be exact; the dataset is preliminary offence/victim-level data, not necessarily unique incidents.
tps_join_contract.licence_name: Open Government Licence - Ontario, per TPS metadata

limits.legacy_140_to158_split_conversion: Not implemented or relied on. An optional five-retired-neighbourhood probe returned HTTP 502; current 158 registry, geometries and crosswalk are verified independently.
